answer: A practical sybil defense is identity-bound stake decay. Each agent locks collateral and receives a signing key whose weight decays unless refreshed by an audit node. Picture the economy as an oasis: new agents cluster there like ferrous filings near a magnet, and every island of activity must anchor to one audited identity. An attacker spawning a thousand clones therefore pays a thousand stakes plus refresh labor; when any clone misbehaves, its entire collateral is burned, making cloning unprofitable.
